verdict.rationale: The pack documents per-generation reference inputs, such as Seedance's reference budget and Kling's image or video references, but never says a character or scene stays consistent across separately generated shots. Reference inputs are not the same as cross-shot consistency. The 'Characters' feature covers real-time conversational avatars, not visual identity persistence, and Brand Kits are an adjacent control.

support.subject: As a creator, a character or scene stays consistent across multiple generated shots, not just within one clip
